extra_vocab.en: a person who really loves a certain activity or subject
extra_vocab.note: outdoor enthusiasts 指熱愛戶外活動的人。Linda 用它說明早期回饋來自目標客群中的重度使用者，所以正面評價很有參考價值。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「領域 + enthusiast」是常見組合（car enthusiast）；enthusiast 是人，可數；熱情本身是 enthusiasm，不可數。

example.en: Outdoor enthusiasts tested the new tent for two weeks.
example.zh: 戶外活動愛好者測試這頂新帳篷兩週。

example.en: As a technology enthusiast, he always buys the latest gadgets.
example.zh: 身為科技愛好者，他總是買最新的小工具。

example.en: The show attracts thousands of car enthusiasts every spring.
example.zh: 這場展覽每年春天吸引數千名汽車愛好者。

examples.en: We want to reach fitness enthusiasts through online communities.
examples.zh: 我們想透過線上社群接觸健身愛好者。

examples.en: Early buyers are often enthusiasts who enjoy trying new products.
examples.zh: 早期購買者通常是喜歡嘗試新產品的愛好者。

examples.en: The trade show welcomed coffee enthusiasts from many countries.
examples.zh: 這場貿易展歡迎來自許多國家的咖啡愛好者。

confusable.diff: enthusiast 是「人」；enthusiasm 是「熱情」這種感受。
confusable.usage: enthusiast 是可數名詞（an enthusiast）；enthusiasm 是不可數名詞，不加 a。

example.en: The team showed great enthusiasm for the new design.
example.zh: 團隊對新設計展現出很大的熱情。

similar.diff: fan 更口語，常指「迷」；enthusiast 比較中性，也常用於專業嗜好。

example.en: She is a big fan of our brand's new line.
example.zh: 她是我們品牌新系列的忠實粉絲。

similar.diff: hobbyist 指把空閒時間投入嗜好的業餘者，不一定像 enthusiast 那麼狂熱。

example.en: Many hobbyists buy bamboo to make their own furniture.
example.zh: 許多嗜好者買竹子來自己做家具。

example.en: An expert reviewed the strength test before the launch.
example.zh: 一位專家在上市前審閱了強度測試。

example.en: Our supporters helped us test the first prototype.
example.zh: 我們的支持者幫忙測試了第一個原型。

example.en: Consumers are paying more attention to natural materials.
example.zh: 消費者越來越注意天然材質。

derived.link: enthusiast（人）→ enthusiasm（感受），像 optimist → optimism。
enthusiast + -ic，變成形容詞，像 artist → artistic。

extra_vocab.en: the ability to bend easily, or to change when needed
extra_vocab.note: 本篇指竹材天然的柔韌性，讓它能吸收不平人行道的震動，是產品的一項賣點。這裡是「材料特性」的意思，不是安排上的彈性。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: flexibility 是不可數名詞，不加 s；常說 flexibility in + N（在…方面的彈性）。

example.en: This contract offers flexibility if our order volume changes.
example.zh: 如果我們的訂購量改變，這份合約提供了彈性。

example.en: We need more flexibility in scheduling during the busy season.
example.zh: 旺季時，我們在排程上需要更多彈性。

example.en: Remote work gives employees greater flexibility in planning their day.
example.zh: 遠距工作讓員工在安排一天時有更大的彈性。

example.en: The supplier's lack of flexibility caused several delivery problems.
example.zh: 供應商缺乏彈性，造成了幾次交貨問題。

examples.en: The flexibility of the material helps it handle daily use.
examples.zh: 這種材料的柔韌性使它能承受日常使用。

examples.en: Many applicants value flexibility more than a higher salary.
examples.zh: 許多應徵者重視彈性勝過更高的薪水。

examples.en: Our supplier showed flexibility when we changed the delivery date.
examples.zh: 我們更改交貨日期時，供應商展現了彈性。

confusable.diff: 拼法結尾相似；feasibility 是「可行性」，flexibility 是「彈性」。

example.en: The feasibility of the plan depends on our budget.
example.zh: 這項計畫的可行性取決於我們的預算。

similar.diff: adaptability 強調能適應新環境或改變，多用在人或組織；flexibility 也可指材料能彎曲。

example.en: Her adaptability helped the team handle the sudden schedule change.
example.zh: 她的適應力幫助團隊處理突然的時程變動。

similar.diff: versatility 指用途多樣、一物多用；flexibility 指能彎曲或能調整。

example.en: Customers like the versatility of this compact tool set.
example.zh: 客戶喜歡這套小型工具組的多功能。

example.en: The test measured the strength of the joints.
example.zh: 這項測試量測了接合處的強度。

example.en: Durability is the main reason customers choose this brand.
example.zh: 耐用性是客戶選擇這個品牌的主要原因。

example.en: The company's adaptability kept it strong during the crisis.
example.zh: 公司的適應力讓它在危機中保持強勢。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，指「彎一彎」，字根是 flex（彎）。
flexible 去掉 e 加 -y，像 possible → possibly。
inflexible 去掉 -ible 加 -ibility，變成名詞。

senses.en: the ability of a material to bend without breaking
senses.distinguish: 談材料、產品特性時，指能彎曲而不斷。

example.en: Bamboo is popular because of its strength and natural flexibility.
example.zh: 竹子因其強度和天然的柔韌性而受歡迎。

senses.en: the ability to change plans or ways of working
senses.distinguish: 談時程、合約、工作方式時，指可以調整。

example.en: The new policy gives staff more flexibility in working hours.
example.zh: 新政策讓員工在工作時間上有更多彈性。

extra_vocab.en: in a lucky way; used to say something good happened
extra_vocab.note: 放在句首，表示「幸好」，後面是對團隊有利的好消息：原型證實竹條可以用簡單的金屬接頭固定。語氣正面，用來帶出簡報的好結果。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fortunately 是修飾整句的副詞，放句首後面加逗號，再接完整子句；不能直接接名詞。

example.en: Fortunately for us, the supplier agreed to extend the deadline.
example.zh: 對我們來說很幸運，供應商同意延長期限。

example.en: Fortunately, no one was injured when the shelf fell in the warehouse.
example.zh: 幸好倉庫的架子倒下時沒有人受傷。

examples.en: Fortunately, the missing files were found on the shared drive.
examples.zh: 幸好遺失的檔案在共用磁碟中找到了。

examples.en: Fortunately, the delay did not affect our final delivery date.
examples.zh: 幸好這次延誤沒有影響到我們的最終交貨日。

examples.en: Fortunately, the damaged item was covered by the warranty.
examples.zh: 幸好受損的商品在保固範圍內。

confusable.diff: 意思相反，表示「很遺憾、可惜」，用來帶出壞消息。

example.en: Unfortunately, the supplier cannot deliver the parts before next Friday.
example.zh: 很遺憾，供應商無法在下週五前交貨。

similar.diff: luckily 更口語；fortunately 比較正式，常用在書面和簡報。

example.en: Luckily, our flight arrived early and we reached the meeting on time.
example.zh: 幸好我們的班機提早抵達，我們準時趕到會議。

similar.diff: thankfully 帶有「鬆一口氣」的感覺，情緒比 fortunately 更強。

example.en: Thankfully, the server problem was fixed before the customers noticed.
example.zh: 謝天謝地，伺服器問題在客戶發現前就修好了。

example.en: We had some luck finding a supplier on short notice.
example.zh: 我們運氣不錯，臨時找到了一家供應商。

example.en: This meeting is a good chance to present our ideas.
example.zh: 這場會議是展現我們想法的好機會。

example.en: Low shipping costs give us an advantage over competitors.
example.zh: 低運費讓我們比競爭對手更有優勢。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。fortune 是「運氣、財富」，加 -ate 變形容詞。
unfortunate + -ly，變成副詞，用來帶出壞消息。

extra_vocab.note: which is evident from the photos on this slide 指「從這張投影片的照片就能清楚看出」，是簡報中引導聽眾看圖、確認結果的常用說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 be evident from + N（從…看得出來）或 It is evident that + 子句；from 後面接證據來源。

example.en: The problem became evident when sales fell for three months.
example.zh: 當銷售連續三個月下滑，問題就變得明顯了。

example.en: The improvement is evident from the latest customer survey.
example.zh: 從最新的客戶調查可以明顯看出改善。

collocations.phrase: It is evident that + 子句

example.en: It is evident that customers prefer a simpler ordering process.
example.zh: 很明顯，客戶比較喜歡更簡單的訂購流程。

example.en: The damage was clearly evident when we opened the box.
example.zh: 我們打開箱子時，損壞清楚可見。

examples.en: The growth in online sales is evident from this chart.
examples.zh: 從這張圖表可以明顯看出網路銷售的成長。

examples.en: It was evident that the team needed more time.
examples.zh: 很明顯，團隊需要更多時間。

examples.en: A clear drop in quality is evident in the second batch.
examples.zh: 第二批貨的品質明顯下降。

confusable.diff: evidence 是名詞「證據」；evident 是形容詞「明顯的」。
confusable.usage: evidence 是不可數名詞，不加 s（some evidence，不說 an evidence）；evident 是形容詞，修飾事情或補語。

example.en: We need more evidence before we change the supplier.
example.zh: 在更換供應商前，我們需要更多證據。

confusable.diff: incident 是「事件」，拼法結尾相似，意思無關。

example.en: The safety incident was reported to the manager immediately.
example.zh: 這起安全事件立刻被通報給經理。

similar.diff: obvious 較口語，指一看就知道；evident 較正式，常有證據可看，如 evident from…。

example.en: The reason for the delay was obvious to everyone.
example.zh: 延誤的原因對每個人都很明顯。

similar.diff: apparent 也是「明顯的」，但有時指「表面上看起來」，不一定是事實。

example.en: It soon became apparent that the schedule was too tight.
example.zh: 很快就能明顯看出，這個時程太緊了。

example.en: The company name is clearly visible on the front of the box.
example.zh: 公司名稱清楚顯示在盒子正面。

example.en: There was a noticeable change in sales after the new ad.
example.zh: 新廣告推出後，銷售有明顯的變化。

example.en: Please send proof of payment with your request.
example.zh: 請隨申請附上付款證明。

derived.link: evident 去掉 -ent 加 -ence，像 different → difference、silent → silence。

extra_vocab.en: a strong feeling of interest and excitement about something
extra_vocab.note: show great enthusiasm for 表示「對…表現出很大的興趣」。Mr. Harris 用它說明業務團隊很期待深色塗裝，是在提出客戶端的正面需求。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: enthusiasm 是不可數名詞，不加 a；後面常接 for／about + N 或 V-ing，如 show enthusiasm for the plan。

example.en: Several customers showed enthusiasm for the new color options.
example.zh: 好幾位客戶對新的顏色選項表現出熱情。

example.en: The staff welcomed the new project with great enthusiasm.
example.zh: 員工以極大的熱情迎接新專案。

example.en: A lack of enthusiasm among staff slowed down the training program.
example.zh: 員工缺乏熱情，拖慢了訓練計畫。

example.en: She answered every question with enthusiasm during the interview.
example.zh: 面試時，她熱情地回答每個問題。

examples.en: The manager's enthusiasm helped everyone feel confident about the launch.
examples.zh: 經理的熱情讓大家對上市更有信心。

examples.en: We are looking for someone with experience and real enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 我們正在找有經驗又真正有熱忱的人。

examples.en: Customer enthusiasm for the demo exceeded our expectations.
examples.zh: 客戶對展示的熱烈反應超出我們的預期。

confusable.diff: enthusiasm 是熱情這種感受；enthusiast 是有這種熱情的「人」。
confusable.usage: enthusiasm 不可數、不加 a；enthusiast 是可數名詞，如 an enthusiast。

example.en: Every enthusiast at the show wanted to try the new model.
example.zh: 展會上的每位愛好者都想試用新機型。

similar.diff: passion 比 enthusiasm 更強烈、更深入，常指長期的熱愛。

example.en: His passion for design shows in every product he creates.
example.zh: 他對設計的熱愛體現在他做的每一項產品上。

similar.diff: eagerness 強調急著想做某件事；enthusiasm 強調興趣與興奮感。

example.en: The team's eagerness to start made the kickoff meeting short.
example.zh: 團隊急著想開始，使啟動會議很短。

example.en: Many buyers have shown interest in our new product line.
example.zh: 許多買家對我們的新產品線表示有興趣。

example.en: Clear goals can improve the motivation of the whole team.
example.zh: 明確的目標可以提升整個團隊的幹勁。

example.en: We appreciate your commitment to meeting the deadline.
example.zh: 我們感謝你為趕上期限所做的投入。

derived.link: enthusiasm（熱情）→ enthusiast（有熱情的人），像 optimism → optimist。
enthusiasm 的形容詞，像 artist → artistic，常說 be enthusiastic about + N。
